_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY -- this policy is not applied from this file.
It is generated at runtime by .github/workflows/sync-hosted-zones.yml from
the roles.cert_manager ARNs in hosted-zones.json, and written to
EKSManagerLetsEncryptRole as a second inline policy named
replaces an inline policy wholesale -- two policies, two owners, so neither
overwrites the other. Terraform owns the other one; the workflow owns this.
The Resource list is exact ARNs, one per zone. No name pattern, no account
wildcard. With no zones configured the policy is deleted rather than
written with an empty Resource, which IAM rejects.
This role holds NO Route53 permission of its own. Every DNS action runs
under the customer's cert_manager role, bounded by what they grant it.
